summary: Nanobiotix S.A. filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, attaching a press release dated July 30, 2026, disclosing routine voting rights and share capital information under French regulations. The release reports 50,825,682 shares outstanding, 54,486,890 theoretical voting rights, and 54,464,772 exercisable voting rights as of June 30, 2026. The filing is a standard disclosure mandated by French law and the AMF, with no transactional elements. No deal terms, board actions, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is a routine regulatory update with no risk-arb or structural angle.
